item.title: Texas ban on smokable THC products to take effect March 31
item.description: New rules were adopted recently by the Texas Department of State Health Services, which prohibit stores from selling any smokable form of THC, including hemp derivatives. The new rules, which take effect at the end of the month, don't affect the sale of most other consumable THC products, such as edibles and infused drinks.
